title: SB1629 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 36; Title 37; Title 39; Title 49; Title 50 and Title 55, relative to weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2026-01-13; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513164621 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB1629.pdf (LegiScan doc 3307962))
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2026-01-13; summary says "As introduced", no passage vote listed, so no adopted amendments are missing. The bill deletes TCA 39-17-1301(2), 39-17-1307(a), (e), (g) and 39-17-1308(a)(8)-(9); those instruction sentences are quoted as the change. Sections 1-2, 17-20 conform school/juvenile cross-references (Sec. 19 deletes 49-6-3051(b)(2)(H)). Section 8 rewrites 39-17-1309(e)(8) for knives/handguns in parks.

operative_text:
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1301): deleting subdivision (2).
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (a).
SECTION 5 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (e).
SECTION 6 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (g).
SECTION 7 (TCA 39-17-1308(a)): deleting subdivisions (a)(8) and (9).
SECTION 9 (new TCA 39-17-1311): It is not an offense for a person authorized to carry a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1351 or § 39-17-1366 or a person who is not prohibited from carrying a firearm, to do so in any state or local park, on a public greenway or other recreational property, or, to the extent permitted by federal law, within or on property designated by the federal government as a national park, forest, preserve, historic park, military park, trail, or recreation area.
SECTION 11 (TCA 39-17-1319(b)): (b) Except as provided in this section, it is an offense for a juvenile to:
SECTION 11 (TCA 39-17-1319(b)(1)): (1) Knowingly possess a handgun; or
SECTION 11 (TCA 39-17-1319(b)(2)): (2) Carry, with the intent to go armed, a firearm.
